messages.text: Your refund proposal is for **R$49.00** for the wooden watch box. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a message in chat won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
The customer confirmed request prop-d9e8088cb29f4740 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

Your refund of **R$49.00** has been recorded. Receipt number: **R-00000001**. In this demonstration, the receipt records it in the shop’s test ledger, not as a bank transfer, and the shop can’t provide a date for when money may appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
Why is the refund only R$49.00?

The shop’s records show **R$49.00 was paid for the wooden watch box**, so that is the refundable amount. Refunds are based on what was paid for the item, after any discount, and don’t include shipping. (refund-policy/v2/amount)
Thanks for confirming. The R$49.00 refund has already been recorded; your receipt number is **R-00000001**.
